title: UI风格#76 - Retro TV Static (复古电视雪花)
description: 创建第76种UI风格：复古电视雪花风格 - CRT电视、静态噪声、失真效果。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planBX.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro TV Static style When color palette Then features gray static, black, white, slight color tint
Given Retro TV Static style When typography Then uses pixelated fonts: VT323, Press Start 2P, or Silkscreen
Given Retro TV Static style When layout Then TV frame, static overlay, rounded corners
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: TV frame with rounded corners, animated static noise overlay, scanline effects, black CRT background

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro TV Static style When UI elements Then static noise, TV glitches, antenna styling
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: animated static noise layer, text glitch animation, scanline overlays, gray-noise borders, CRT styling throughout

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro TV Static UI When functional Then includes static chat, fuzzy agents, signal stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: screen chat (Channel 3), 4 channel agents (CRT/VHS/Film/Radio) with Snow/Clear/Lines/Scan/Frames/Grain/Freq/Tune stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Retro TV Static UI When copy Then uses TV language: 'Signal', 'Static', 'Channel', 'Tune'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'STATIC. SIGNAL. CHANNEL.', tagline 'TUNING IN FROM THE PAST', button 'TUNE', greeting 'BZZZ... We're on the air', status 'Watching'/'Idle', nav 'Home'/'Repair'/'Archive'/'Controls'
